APPROVED (D-100): "approved style plan but we need more intricate level design now we have fixed position sorted", every recommendation: OQ1 retire the broad key on the bridge; OQ2 three bands; OQ3 Josefin Sans + Nunito; OQ4 hand-drawn ink border; OQ5 physics overlays keep functional colours; OQ6 below-rail cues now; OQ7 bridge and HUD only. Intricate level design goes to the levels design (R2 levels), not this sprint.

D-104 amendment (Mark, attended): "everything looks quite boxy with edges, isn't the style more rounded curves?" Shape language S7 folded in: the desks, chair and screen housings grown at ST2 (stapledon_bridge_props_v3.py reshape()), the rail/guardrails/lift guides at ST3, the benches/Archive terminal/conduits at ST5; metric: straight-edge share <= 0.10 on manifest style.shaped (AC12). Estimate 8.5 -> 10 days, ~1,300 -> ~1,360 game LOC, ~500 -> ~800 bpy.

D-106 amendment (Mark chose painted foliage cards, spike PR #299): the bridge's rim fronds swap to painted cards in ST5, lit through a rounded normal by the shared toon material (the spike's card shader merged in as a card mode, no second shader), clamped to +-25 deg toward the camera, evenly lit paintings, proxy shadow casters for big plants, the occluder fade kept. Estimate 10 -> 10.5 days, ~1,360 -> ~1,440 game LOC. ST2 unchanged.

ST0-ST2 built; paused at the ST2 style frame for Mark (look, bands, typeface, panel and the D-104 shapes). PR #300 (supersedes #293); dev build v0.4.0-dev.35-bow-view-22-g4e6b0d33; frames refs/bridge_style/st2/.

reviews.resolution: All folded in 2026-10-20: shader spec with exclusions and next_pass exactly the ink; membership by the bridge_style group and manifest style.bridge_nodes; the three changing key checks listed and the level switch defined; the spire's shadow opacity follows the key's ramp with boundary tests; fonts (OFL, pinned) and a seeded ink border tool; deck/spire at 1024^2 (~28 MB) with a runtime-compression fallback; 1,300 LOC over 8.5 days, ST5 split into ST5 dressing and ST6 landing, ST3 2 days; ui-theme-check covers ui/ and the demo HUD with explicit allow-lists. Suggestions taken: named sky layers in AC3, the SubViewport note, a slide flicker bound, the AC9 rerun rule, a dressing negative control, below-rail outside lower decks, the mock tool committed as review-only, OQ3's default recorded at approval, the D-96 framing hook, S4 as a separable PR.
